name: PLUST ~Ore o Osu made, Ai Shite Ageru~
original_name: PLUST～オレを推すまで、愛してあげる～
source:
I'm an ordinary office worker, but I ended up living with Japan's top idol group! However, I stan their rivals, but this only makes them more motivated...

Smiling 24 hours a day, sending winks and kisses, getting closer to me...

Is this just fanservice? Or something more? My heart skips a beat when I meet their gaze...

"What if I told you I'm serious?"
translation:
我是一个普通的上班族，却和日本顶级偶像组合住在一起了！然而，我斯坦了他们的对手，但这只会让他们更有动力……

一天24小时微笑，眨眼，亲吻，离我越来越近……

这只是粉丝服务吗？或者更多？当我看到他们的目光时，我的心猛地跳了一下……

“如果我告诉你我是认真的呢？”
